readThrough.checks: Every field of all ten episodes read against the P2 scope (L1–3 secondo me/per me/la mia opinione + indicativo + perché; L4–6 anche se + indicativo, comunque; L7–10 penso/credo che + whitelisted congiuntivo sia/siano/possa/serva/aiuti). Formal Lei and German Sie throughout; no learner essere compounds, reflexives, preceding clitics or speaker adjectives (ho visto, ho conosciuto only). Chunks reconstruct turn 1 in every lesson and no chip rearrangement survives with identical orthography/casing; recall answers are single words with fallback forms that fail agreement in context; speech tokens all occur in turn 1; cloze blanks have literal subjects before them and one syntactically valid choice; pattern examples reuse an episode turn; scene captions quote the opening verbatim and reveal no later turn; situations and titles spoil nothing; trophies are the frozen words and appear in turn 1 and example. 'la strada è chiusa' (L4 example) is adjectival state, not a participial passive, so it does not breach the pre-P6 ban.
readThrough.remainingConcerns: L3 'il consiglio personale' is an acceptable but slightly stiff rendering of Beratung (consulenza personalizzata is more idiomatic); the interlocutor's 'La consulenza è utile' anchors the meaning, and changing it would cascade through recall/terms, so it is left as-is. L1 'La mia opinione è favorevole' is formal but native and explicitly scoped in the anchor.

readThrough.checks: Every field read against P3 scope (L1–3 vorrei/preferirei + noun/infinitive; L4–6 potrei/potrebbe/sarebbe possibile, mi andrebbe bene; L7–10 dovrei/dovrebbe, Le andrebbe bene?, fixed se possibile). No se + congiuntivo imperfetto, no condizionale passato, no futuro, no avrei bisogno che. Formal Lei/Sie everywhere; interlocutor 'La uso' is present tense in a non-learner turn and is not a preceding-clitic compound. Client never decides for the manager/office (potrebbe suggestions, questions). Chunk reconstruction verified for all ten; L9 admits an alternative native ordering with identical chips (fixed below); L6 rearrangement would require a case change and is not a strict-equality trap. Cloze subjects (io, il furgone, il tecnico, il corso, Lei, una lezione breve) are literal and precede their blanks; recall/speech tokens valid; captions, situations and titles spoiler-free; trophies frozen and anchored.
readThrough.remainingConcerns: L2 teaches ci sarebbe la possibilità di in both pattern examples before productive sarebbe at L4–6; it is a fixed politeness frame tied to the frozen beat and is now explicitly licensed as a lexical chunk in the anchor and pedagogicalGoal (edits below). L6 'lezione breve' after 'only the start can change; room closes at nine' is coherent (later start = shorter lesson).

arbitration.finding: HIGH P2L2/L3/L4 second finite blanks (posso/compro/accompagnano) allow a different implicit subject after quindi/e
arbitration.reason: The governing proDropRule defines disambiguation as cue 'infinitive (subject)' plus the subject literal visible before the blank; all three blanks satisfy both (Io/I genitori precede, cue names io/i genitori), and the validator enforces exactly this. With the cue naming the person, possiamo/compriamo/accompagno are not valid answers in the actual visible context; coordinated same-subject verbs are the standard same-person case the contract prefers. The proposed rewrites would alter approved learner turns (cerco di comprare, per accompagnare) without contract gain.

arbitration.finding: HIGH P3L9 chips 'la proposta' + 'con calma' permit 'Vorrei valutare con calma la proposta …', a native ordering that fails strict equality
arbitration.reason: Verified: identical orthography and casing, so a correct learner build would be marked wrong. Merge into 'la proposta con calma' (4 chunks, min satisfied; chips remain distinct from distractors).

arbitration.finding: MEDIUM P3L2 ci sarebbe la possibilità di ahead of L4–6 sarebbe
arbitration.reason: Fable explicitly licenses this narrow preview: the frame is a fixed, highly native politeness question tied to the frozen beat and trophy possibilità, taught as a lexical chunk, not as productive conditional; no other L1–3 surface uses sarebbe. The anchor and the lesson's pedagogicalGoal are revised to state the license instead of 'pending'; the reviewer's 'Vorrei avere la possibilità…' rewrite is not applied.
